logical_model.summary: Logical design for datamodel, derived from the conceptual model. 7 entities carry 6 relationships: 1 associative entities resolve many-to-many relationships and 0 entities are identified through a parent. 0 entities required a surrogate identifier because no business key was recorded. Attributes are typed against abstract domains and carry no platform-specific length, precision or storage.

subject_areas.name: Customer Management
subject_areas.description: Core customer identity, contact information, and credit management.

subject_areas.name: Product Catalog
subject_areas.description: Product definitions, inventory levels, and supplier relationships.

subject_areas.name: Order Fulfillment
subject_areas.description: Order creation, line item tracking, status, and shipping.

subject_areas.name: Unassigned
subject_areas.description: Entities the conceptual model placed in no domain.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A party who places orders and purchases products. Identified by a unique customer code.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A customer purchase transaction containing one or more products, with order status, payment details, and fulfillment tracking.

entities.name: Order Item
entities.description: A denormalized order line containing product and pricing details. This entity appears to duplicate Order Product but retains product name as a text field rather than reference.

entities.name: Order Line Item
entities.description: A line item within an order, capturing the product name, quantity ordered, and pricing at order time. Denormalizes product information at the point of order.

entities.name: Order Product
entities.description: A line item that links an order to a product with the quantity and selling price at the time of order. Serves as the transaction record for product fulfillment.

entities.name: Order Product Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Order and Product. Each occurrence records that one Order references one Product.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: An item offered for sale. Tracked by product code, with inventory, pricing, category, and supplier information.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Order and Product
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Line Item has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, unit_price, total_price) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Product has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, selling_price) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Order Item
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item references Order, which references Customer. The chain is already decomposed, so Customer's attributes reach Order Item by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Order Product
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Product references Order, which references Customer. The chain is already decomposed, so Customer's attributes reach Order Product by navigation rather than by duplication.
